items.title: A new deep learning model maps global methane emissions from space.
items.content: Google and NASA JPL developed an AI model to map and quantify global methane emissions from space using EMIT.
items.contentSnippet: Google and NASA JPL developed an AI model to map and quantify global methane emissions from space using EMIT.

summaries.zh: 谷歌与NASA JPL合作开发了一种人工智能模型，利用EMIT卫星从太空绘制并量化全球甲烷排放。该模型通过深度学习技术，实现了对全球甲烷排放源的精准识别和监测。
summaries.en: Google and NASA JPL have created a new deep learning model to map and quantify global methane emissions from space. The model utilizes data from the Earth Surface Mineral Dust Transport (EMIT) instrument. This technology enables precise detection and measurement of methane sources worldwide, aiding in environmental monitoring and climate research. The collaboration aims to improve understanding of methane distribution and contribute to efforts in reducing emissions.

items.summary: 谷歌与NASA JPL合作开发了一种人工智能模型，利用EMIT卫星从太空绘制并量化全球甲烷排放。该模型通过深度学习技术，实现了对全球甲烷排放源的精准识别和监测。

items.title: Recreating a 70-year love story frame by frame
items.content: Discover how filmmakers and Google DeepMind used AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded past in the short film "Love, Rendered."
items.contentSnippet: Discover how filmmakers and Google DeepMind used AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded past in the short film "Love, Rendered."

summaries.zh: 影片《Love, Rendered》展示了电影制作人和谷歌DeepMind如何运用人工智能技术，通过画面重构的方式，再现了一对恋人未记录的过去。该短片以逐帧重制的创新手法，呈现了一段跨越70年的爱情故事，展现了科技在艺术创作中的应用。
summaries.en: The short film "Love, Rendered" showcases filmmakers and Google DeepMind using AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded 70-year love story frame by frame. The project leverages artificial intelligence to visualize their shared history, filling in gaps with detailed recreations based on limited information. The result is a poignant visual narrative that brings their past to life.

items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: a high-resolution map of human DNA
items.content: We’re introducing AlphaGenome Atlas, a database predicting the effects of every possible single nucleotide variant in the human genome.
items.contentSnippet: We’re introducing AlphaGenome Atlas, a database predicting the effects of every possible single nucleotide variant in the human genome.

name: Pushmeet Kohli
title: VP Science, Google DeepMind & Chief Scientist, Google Cloud

summaries.zh: AlphaGenome Atlas是一个预测人类基因组中每个可能单核苷酸变异影响的数据库。该数据库提供了高分辨率的人类DNA图谱，为基因变异研究提供了全面的数据支持。
summaries.en: The AlphaGenome Atlas is a database that predicts the effects of all possible single nucleotide variants in the human genome. It provides a high-resolution map of human DNA, offering comprehensive insights into genetic variations and their potential impacts. The resource aims to enhance understanding of genetic diversity and its implications for health and disease.
